Airport Transfers

Exeter airport transfers, without the stress.

Start and end your trip the easy way. We provide pre-booked airport transfers from Exeter and across Devon to major UK airports — with meet & greet on request and flight-delay waiting included in your quote, so a late landing never leaves you stranded.

  • Meet & greet available — your driver waiting in arrivals
  • Flight-delay waiting included in your quote
  • Help with luggage, door to door
  • Fare and journey time confirmed in your quote — no fixed-price surprises

About Sky Private Hire

A local Exeter service, built around you.

Sky Private Hire Taxi is a professional local transport service based in Exeter, Devon. We focus on the things that matter on every journey: reliability, comfort and genuine customer satisfaction.

Whether it is a short trip across the city, a pre-booked early-morning airport run, or a long-distance journey across the UK, every booking is handled with the same care — a clear quote, a punctual pickup and a comfortable car.
